commands.name: meter
commands.description: The plan's five-hour usage across every session: effective tokens, the share of the limit, the reset, each session's share, the limit hits, the weights
commands.output:
Usage in the last 5h, all sessions: 0 eff (no turns counted yet)
Estimate: no limit hit seen yet, so the cap is unknown until the first
API five-hour window: no reading yet
Sessions in the window: 0
Limit hits: none yet
Weights: eff = input + 0.1·cache read + 2·cache write + 5·output, an estimate of what the session limit meters; the API line is the limit’s own reading.
Settings: window 5h · refresh every 30s · warn at 80%

tools.name: usage_status
tools.description: The plan's rolling five-hour usage across every Claude Code session on this Mac: effective tokens in the window, the share of the limit used (the API's own reading when fresh, else the estimate against the last limit hit), when the window resets, each session’s share and the limit hits seen. Check it before fanning out subagents or starting optional work when the budget is tight; it reads the shared files and makes no model call.
